description: The line plot illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity of three pruned large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—under 70% sparsity using OWL, with perplexity plotted against the pruning parameter M ranging from 3 to 8. The x-axis, labeled “M,” is linear and spans integer values from 3 to 8, with tick marks at each integer. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity,” is linear and ranges from 20.0 to 40.0, with major ticks at intervals of 10.0. The blue line with triangular markers, representing Vicuna-7B, begins at approximately 41.0 at M=3, declines steadily to a minimum of 30.0 at M=7, then rises slightly to 39.0 at M=8. The green line with circular markers, corresponding to LLaMA1-7B, starts at 28.0 at M=3, dips to 24.0 at M=5, and then increases gradually to 36.0 at M=8. The orange line with star markers, for LLaMA1-13B, begins at 20.0 at M=3, decreases to a low of 14.0 at M=6, and then rises back to 20.0 at M=8. Across the entire range of M, LLaMA1-13B maintains the lowest perplexity, while Vicuna-7B consistently exhibits the highest.
caption_used: WikiText validation perplexity of LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B pruned by various M at 70% sparsity using OWL. The perplexity values are plotted against M, ranging from 3 to 8 on the x-axis, with the y-axis representing perplexity values from 20.0 to 40.0. Vicuna-7B (blue line with triangular markers) exhibits a sharp decline from approximately 41.0 at M=3 to a minimum of 30.0 at M=7, followed by a slight increase to 39.0 at M=8. LLaMA1-7B (green line with circular markers) starts at a perplexity of 28.0 at M=3, reaches a minimum of 24.0 at M=5, and increases steadily to 36.0 at M=8. LLaMA1-13B (orange line with star markers) begins at 20.0 at M=3, decreases to a minimum of 14.0 at M=6, and stabilizes at 20.0 by M=8. LLaMA1-13B consistently outperforms the other models across all values of M, with Vicuna-7B showing the highest perplexity throughout the range.
